name: Taiki (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Taiki town emblem in white: a ring of concentric arcs enclosing the characters 大樹.
history: Municipal flag of Taiki, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 23 February 1950.

features.role: Taiki town emblem — a ring of concentric arcs enclosing the characters 大樹
